verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a published pricing page. The quoted items show some plan features (SSO, 2FA) and say feature flags and environments are unlimited, which suggests those are not cost drivers. The evidence shows no actual prices and does not identify what drives cost, such as seats, MAUs or API requests. missing for 10: published price points per tier, explicit cost drivers (seats/MAUs/requests/events), overage or limit details, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
